## Goal
A table-driven suite for the matcher's name handling: nicknames (both directions), hyphenated and double surnames, Jr/Sr/III suffixes, diacritics, apostrophes, initials, the SEC-103 other-person cases (Pat/Patrick etc. must be POSSIBLE, Peggy/Margaret CONFIRMED). Read src/freemyid/engine/matcher.py and nicknames.py first.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- New test files only, named `test_cx_*.py` / `test_cp_*.py` (unique basenames across tests/). Offline, no new dependencies.
- A real product bug: strict xfail on that case only, with a reason naming the file:line, reported in VENDOR_STATUS.md. Never change `src/`.
- Run the new tests and ruff on your files and report real numbers.
- Create no files outside the allowed paths (no scratch, backup or .new/.tmp copies).

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- tests/codex/test_cx_name_variants.py
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
src/, every existing file not listed above, every other lane in docs/BACKLOG.md.

VENDOR_STATUS.md when done; the team lead summarises in the channel.
